D: Oil drillers are sent into space to blow up an asteroid heading for Earth.
P: Serve dessert when AJ does the animal cracker scene.
S: the most famous animal crackers in movie history
Simple vanilla biscuit dough (butter, sugar, flour, honey) rolled thin, cut with small animal cutters, baked at 170C for 10 minutes.
Harry's rig in the middle of the ocean
Topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, black pepper and brown sugar, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: Beef chuck chunks browned, onion, garlic, chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans, braised 2.5 hours. Cornbread.
steak, mash and gravy before launch
Rib eye seared and rested, buttery mash and onion gravy (onions cooked down, flour, beef stock).

s.note: the most famous animal crackers in movie history
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 80g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then mix in 250g flour. Roll thin and cut with small animal cutters. Bake at 170C for 10 minutes until pale golden. Cool on a rack and pile into a bowl.

s.note: Harry's rig in the middle of the ocean
s.how: Slice 600g beef topside 3mm thick across the grain. Marinate overnight in 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp cracked black pepper. Lay on racks and dry at 70C with the oven door ajar for 4 hours until leathery but bendy.

m.note: steak, mash and gravy before launch
m.how: Mash 1kg potatoes with 80g butter and milk. Cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 20 minutes, stir in 1 tbsp flour and add 400ml beef stock, then simmer. Sear 4 rib eyes hard, rest 5 minutes and pour the gravy over.

w.how: Make a batch of animal biscuits from 125g butter, 80g sugar and 250g flour, baked at 170C for 10 minutes. Dip each half into 250g melted pink or white candy melts and add sprinkles. Serve with a bowl of 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: the crew's list of demands before launch
d.how: Chill eight 355ml bottles of American lager for at least three hours, or in a bucket of ice for 30 minutes. Hand them out cold and toast the crew who made it home.
